act_name: Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2020 / Punjab 2021
title: Complaint to Ombudsman regarding harassment or illegal deprivation of property
source_citation: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2020 / Punjab 2021
verbatim_text: (1) Any woman who is deprived of ownership or possession of her property, by any person through fraud, coercion, force or any illegal means, may file a complaint to the Ombudsman: Provided that the Ombudsman shall decide the complaint within sixty days from receipt thereof.
provisos: Provided that the Ombudsman shall decide the complaint within sixty days from receipt thereof.

act_name: Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2020 / Punjab 2021
title: Delivery of possession by Ombudsman through police / local administration
source_citation: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2020 / Punjab 2021
verbatim_text: (1) The Ombudsman may, on finding that a woman has been illegally deprived of possession of her property, direct the Deputy Commissioner or local administration to restore possession of the property to the complainant.
